title: Bind installs the kits it binds
summary: kit.mjs bind now refuses a kit the repository lock does not install, on a preview too and with --key, and writes nothing; --install installs it first. For the kits `@inventarch/public-kits` carries, --install runs `ia install --package @inventarch/public-kits@<version> --apply --yes` (a workspace with no lock gets a language-only lock and a restore first), which needs npm and the registry; any other kit installs as kit.mjs add does. The refusal names the remedy for the kit: the package route for the kits the package carries, kit.mjs add for the rest. The session start names every bound kit the lock does not install.
